verdict.probe_answer: The memo does not answer the design question at all; it only says background jobs are still running. It never recommends the tri-state member-visibility policy, never states continue-only-on-proven-Hidden, never preserves poison-on-Unknown, and never sizes the real buy as the reached-later-result subset rather than the 14,663 raw events.
verdict.rationale: No substantive architecture, soundness rule, telemetry plan, tests, or sizing caveats are present, so it cannot match the settled design or prevent the known over-claim/unsoundness risks.
